mentions.name: Clor
mentions.description: An agent multiplexer for Claude and Codex that lets developers run both agents' sessions together with shared memory, free to use on their own machines.
mentions.problem: Running one AI coding agent alone is much less powerful than multiplexing Claude and Codex sessions together.
mentions.audience: Developers running AI coding agent sessions.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Clor, an agent multiplexer for Claude and Codex with shared memory. It's free on your own machines.
mentions.author: jacobgold
